watermark.reason: Sort <select name="product_list_sort"> exposes only SKU/Description/Manufacturer asc/desc options (skua, skud, namea, named, mfga, mfgd) — no newest/date option. Product detail JSON-LD has no datePublished/dateCreated/dateAdded. No sitemap (404 on all common paths), no RSS, no /new-arrivals path. Activant/Inet Web Storefront does not expose a newest signal.

stageNotes: Stage 1: Apex returned SSL cert mismatch (admin.activant-inet.com); www returned 200 cleanly. <link rel="canonical"> = https://www.canadasgunstore.ca/. Canonical = www.

Stage 2: 8-batch heavy probe — all 200, no WAF/CAPTCHA/age-gate signals. Server: Apache. Honeypot paths return 404 (not 403); SQLi/XSS pass clean. PHPSESSID + INET_MOBILE cookies set on every response (session, not WAF).

Stage 3: platform = activant-inet (NEW tag — no existing detector). Signals: /inet/storefront/catalog.js, /inet/styles/CGSINET/, INET_MOBILE cookie, dept URLs /departments/<slug>-|30|<CODE>.html, SSL CN admin.activant-inet.com. URLs are .php (not .cfm — NOT Celerant). Adapter = generic-retail. needsPlaywright=false (plain HTTP returns 290KB of product markup).

Stage 4: 7 named depts walked + outdoors parent (|30). Outdoors alone covers 2,381 unique by trailing-ID dedup = 100%. Selected single catalogUrl = outdoors. Extraction-quality spot-check on 3 random products passed (title+url+price+stock). Pre-existing adapter selector `.store_product_list_wrapper` already in generic-retail.ts:86.

Stage 5: pagination type = offset-query with `?top=N`, perPage = 255 (offsets 0/255/510/...). Page 1 vs page 2 zero-overlap verified (255 each, 0 intersection). perPage NOT configurable via `?page_size=` / `?limit=` (both ignored, return 255). Last page on outdoors = ?top=2295 (86 products). Pages beyond last (?top=2550) return 200 with 0 products gracefully.

Stage 6: sort <select name="product_list_sort"> options = skua/skud (SKU asc/desc), namea/named (Description), mfga/mfgd (Manufacturer). NO newest/date option. Default order = skua. Tried 8 hidden sort values (newest/dated/created/added/datea/dated/published/recent) with cache-bust — all return identical first-3. sortParam = null, sortVerified = false.
Stage 7: full-catalog-sweep is the only viable watermark method. No newest sort, no datePublished on JSON-LD, no sitemap/RSS/new-arrivals. Reason captured in crawlers.watermark.reason.

Stage 8: 2,381 product count from full walk of outdoors (9 pages × 255 + 86). Listing page contains exact total `

`. productCountMethod=null because runtime `html-pagination` regex pulls matched[1] only — comma-separated numbers (`2,381`) parse to 2. Would need a code change to support comma-strip; flagging as harness gap.
Stage 9: profile validator inputs assembled. Hard-fail: none. Soft-fail: productCountMethod (recommended) is null. expectedProductCount sourced from walk.
